info.description:
AI Governance Control Plane for Enterprise LLMs

## Authentication

Operator endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tenant-scoped requests also use `X-AI-Governance-Organization-Id` and, where applicable, `X-AI-Governance-Project-Id`. Tokens entered into this reference are kept only for the current browser session.
